fields.description:
Number of work injury leave days that are fully paid by the company.
Salary deduction starts after this period.
fields.label: Employee Paid Days

fields.description:
Percentage deducted from the employee's salary after the fully paid period ends.
For example, 25% means the employee receives 75% of their daily wage.
fields.label: Deduction Percentage

fields.description: Require medical approval before a work injury request can be submitted or approved.
fields.label: Require Medical Approval

fields.description: Maximum allowed treatment cost for a work injury claim.
fields.label: Treatment Cost Limit

fields.description:
Action to take when the treatment cost exceeds the configured limit.
1- Stop: Prevent the work injury request from being submitted.
2- Warn: Display a warning message but allow the user to continue.
3- Ignore: Do not perform any validation and allow the request to proceed without notification.
fields.label: Action for Cost Limit

fields.description: Enable a maximum treatment cost limit for work injury claims.
fields.label: Enable Cost Limit

fields.description: Select the leave type that will be automatically applied to attendance records for employees during the work injury period. This leave type is used when creating attendance and leave entries.
fields.label: Leave Type

fields.description:
Select the salary component used to calculate work injury compensation:
Basic Salary – Compensation is calculated based on the employee's basic salary only.
Earning Salary – Compensation is calculated based on earnings that are prorated by payment days. Fixed earnings that are not affected by payment days are not included in the calculation.
fields.label: Wage Calculation Base

fields.description: Salary component used as the daily wage basis when Wage Calculation Base is Basic Salary.
fields.label: Basic Salary Component

fields.description: Deduction salary component used to post the work injury salary deduction on the Salary Slip.
fields.label: Injury Deduction Component
